changes: Backtick identifier -> PostgreSQL lowercase-folded identifier; quoting retained only for reserved/syntactically unusual/colliding names.
Removed integer display width; verify source does not rely on display formatting.

Identity spelling -> GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY; source seed/increment retained when explicit. NULL/zero, explicit-value sequence advancement and exhaustion differ across engines; review required.
Inline ordinary index -> standalone unnamed PostgreSQL index; columns retained, index name is not a scored constraint.
Type tinyint -> SMALLINT; domain/storage differences require review.
Type blob -> BYTEA; domain/storage differences require review.
Type datetime -> TIMESTAMP; domain/storage differences require review.
Type double -> DOUBLE PRECISION; domain/storage differences require review.
Removed physical ENGINE/table encoding option; encoding/collation review required.
Installed FKs after additive table/key definitions to support forward/cyclic declarations; targets, columns and actions retained; no FK or key was added or removed.
